verdict.rationale: Consensus markets its literature-review feature as letting you 'search, screen, extract, and synthesize evidence'. It documents per-paper extraction of study design and PICO elements, study-type and year filters, and Deep Search lit reviews across many studies, so it has its own screening and extraction capability. The evidence does not show a user-defined systematic workflow, such as custom inclusion/exclusion criteria or custom extraction fields applied consistently across a paper set. Missing for 10: user-defined screening criteria applied uniformly across a corpus, custom extraction schemas or tables, screening decision tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
